notes: Money is converted at release-year World Bank rates and inflated with CPI to 2025 USD.
Films before 1913 have no 2025 USD value (the CPI series starts in 1913), and neither do non-USD amounts from a year without a World Bank rate.
Budgets under $1,000 and revenues under $10,000 are dropped as unreliable.
Fuzzy title matches to The Numbers are flagged (money_fuzzy).
Genre shares use 1/n weights: a film with n genres counts 1/n in each.
The TMDB average is null under 50 votes.
Rotten Tomatoes scores of films from 2023 on come from the RT pages (October 2026), older ones from the April 2023 Clapper dump; newer audience scores are often RT's verified score.
Netflix shares cover only matched titles; see the coverage column.
Scores are on 0–100: IMDb, TMDB and Metacritic users ×10, Letterboxd ×20. The Metacritic user score is null under 10 user ratings.
Cinema genre shares come from LUMIERE admissions of notable films only; UK and Ireland admissions are LUMIERE estimates, and the combined UK+Ireland market counts as the UK.
